queries: WITH ev AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, AVG(spent * 1.0 / amount) AS spend_ratio FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM ev) SELECT ev.event_id, ev.spend_ratio, ev.spend_ratio / overall.avg_ratio AS relative_ratio FROM ev CROSS JOIN overall ORDER BY (ev.spend_ratio / overall.avg_ratio) IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC, ev.event_id LIMIT 10

WITH ev AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, AVG(spent * 1.0 / NULLIF(amount, 0)) AS spend_ratio FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM ev) SELECT ev.event_id, ev.spend_ratio, ev.spend_ratio / overall.avg_ratio AS relative_ratio FROM ev CROSS JOIN overall ORDER BY (ev.spend_ratio / overall.avg_ratio) IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Budget lines with amount = 0 (division by zero gives NULL in SQLite) or NULL spent/amount are treated as missing and skipped in the per-event average.
Events whose ratio is entirely missing are still included in the event list but are skipped by the overall average (AVG ignores NULL) and sort last.
Budget rows with a NULL link_to_event are not counted as an event.
Ties in the relative figure are broken by event_id for a deterministic top 10.

responses.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, AVG(spent / amount) AS spend_ratio FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event) SELECT event_id, spend_ratio, spend_ratio / (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) FROM ev) AS relative_ratio FROM ev ORDER BY (spend_ratio / (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) FROM ev)) IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Budget lines with amount = 0 give a NULL line ratio (SQLite returns NULL on division by zero), and NULL spent or amount are likewise ignored, so they are skipped in the event average.
Events whose lines all have NULL ratios keep a NULL spend ratio. They stay in the list but are excluded from the overall average (AVG ignores NULLs), and they sort last.
Budget rows with a NULL link_to_event are excluded because they do not belong to any event.

responses.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, AVG(spent * 1.0 / NULLIF(amount, 0)) AS spend_ratio FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM ev) SELECT ev.event_id, ev.spend_ratio, ev.spend_ratio / overall.avg_ratio AS relative_ratio FROM ev CROSS JOIN overall ORDER BY (ev.spend_ratio / overall.avg_ratio) IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Budget lines with amount = 0 or NULL, or with NULL spent, have no line-level ratio. They are ignored in the event average. Zero amounts are treated as missing, not as errors.
Events whose lines all lack a ratio keep a NULL spend ratio. They are left out of the overall average and sort last.
Only events that appear in budget.link_to_event are included. Budget rows with a NULL event link are excluded.
